result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I ran the `*SalesRep*` and `*PurchaseOrder*` test classes and they passed (exit code 0). I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, and I didn't run your January example directly.

In `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6514), I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. I also updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled". The query is otherwise unchanged, so reps with no purchase orders still show 0 and the highest count still comes first.
